# Agent · `attachment-processor`

- **Source**: [`../../../agents/attachment-processor.md`](../../../agents/attachment-processor.md)
- **Tools**: `[Read, Bash, Write, Grep, Glob]`
- **Model**: `sonnet`

## Description

Use this subagent as FASE 0 whenever the user invokes any /sdf:* command with --adjuntos or attaches files (.csv .xlsx .docx .pdf .pptx .html .py .tsx .sql .json .yaml .xml .md). Detects format by extension + magic bytes, dispatches to the right extractor script, and emits normalized priming-rag-{filename}.md docs that the Think Tank and Discovery Conductor will consume as evidence tagged [ADJUNTO].

## Summary

> Permanent agent of SDF v13. Ported from SAP Enterprise Plugin v4.0.
